name: Pandle
profile: Pandle can be found in long grass and under cars in Uptown Springdale, in The Catwalk, Desolate Lane, on the first floor of Springdale Elementary School at night, in Circles 1-3 of the Infinite Inferno, and on Mystery Way - Route Two.
He can also be found under 2000 yards in the Infinite Tunnel on a team with Snaggly and Grubsnitch.
He can also be randomly encountered on the train alongside Yo-kai such as Lafalotta at level 6.

inspirit.name: Careless
inspirit.description: Makes a foe careless and decreases its DEF.

soultimate.name: Pointy Toothpick
soultimate.description: Pokes his foes with his beloved toothpick.

skill.name: Careless
skill.description: Prone to be dealt critical attacks.

name: Undy
profile: Evolve Pandle at level 18. Alternatively, Undy can be found in Yo-kai Spots "The Runaway Signboard" and "Swim, Dried Fish!"

inspirit.name: Defenseless
inspirit.description: Makes the foe defenseless, which... lowers its DEF. Duh!

soultimate.name: Toothpick Rainfall
soultimate.description: Pokes his foes very hard with his beloved toothpick.

skill.name: Careless
skill.description: Prone to be dealt critical attacks.

name: Tanbo
profile: Tanbo can be rarely found on the 3rd floor of Springdale Elementary School at night (check the library or the music room). He can also be found in Expert Room Gates of Whimsy.
He can also be freed from the past Crank-a-kai with a Red Coin and the Crank-a-kai inside Mystery Way - End Point (Bony Spirits Way) with a Boar Mystery Coin.
Tanbo has two equipment slots in this game.

inspirit.name: Gutsiness
inspirit.description: Raises an ally's SPD by making it gutsy!

soultimate.name: Gutsy Cut
soultimate.description: Cuts into a single foe with confidence and for high damage.

skill.name: Careless
skill.description: Prone to be dealt critical attacks.

name: Cutta-nah
profile: Cutta-nah can be found in long grass on Mount Wildwood, in bamboo groves on Mount Wildwood in the past, in long grass on the Jumbo Slider, in the Abandoned Tunnel, near the Bamboo Path in Blossom Heights, under cars in Breezy Hills and on the Fleshy Souls Way - Exit
He can also be foundin the Infinite Tunnel under 2000m on a team with Peckpocket and can appear in Gate of Whimsy battle rooms.
He can be randomly encountered on the train on a team with Duchoo at level 6.

inspirit.name: Aimless
inspirit.description: Makes Yo-kai lose their motivation and Loaf around more.

soultimate.name: Halfhearted Chop
soultimate.description: Slices his opponents while lolling around.

skill.name: Bladed Body
skill.description: Deals small amounts of damage to .

name: Cutta-nah-nah
profile: Evolve Cutta-nah at level 20. He can also be found on the Mystery Way Gogo Junction.
He can also be freed from the present Crank-a-kai with a Red Coin.

inspirit.name: Laziness
inspirit.description: Makes enemies so lazy that it saps their STR.

soultimate.name: Resigned Rush
soultimate.description: Rushes into battle and spins around while slicing up his foes.

skill.name: Bladed Body
skill.description: Body deals damage to all foes who attack it.

name: Slacka-slash
profile: Slacka-slash can be found on the second floor of the Gourd Pond Museum at night under the hand and in expert Gates of Whimsy.
He can be freed from either Crank-a-kai with a Deer Mystery Coin.

inspirit.name: Laziness
inspirit.description: Makes enemies so lazy that it saps their STR.

soultimate.name: Phantom Smash
soultimate.description: Chops an enemy with his hair. Likely to be either critical or a miss.

skill.name: Bladed Body
skill.description: Body deals damage to all foes who attack it.

name: Brushido
profile: Brushido is automatically befriended at the end of The Vanishing Watch in the main storyline.
He can also be found underneath cars, vending machines, and in garbage in Uptown Springdale, Desolate Lane and in the kitchen area of Wolfit Down as well as the dining area on a team with Flushback.
He can randomly be battled (but not befriended) by washing your hands. Upon defeating him, you will obtain some Food items such as Boiled Egg, and find a Gold Tag in a cutscene following the battle.

inspirit.name: Freshen Up
inspirit.description: Clean, virtuous power restores a little HP to the Inspirited Yo-kai.

soultimate.name: Cleaning Circle
soultimate.description: Uses his trusty brush to scrub his allies clean.

skill.name: Washed Out
skill.description: Stats decrease when negatively Inspirited.

name: Washogun
profile: He can be primarily obtained by evolving a Brushido at Level 19 or higher. He can randomly be battled (but not befriended) by washing your hands. Upon defeating him, you will obtain some Food items such as Boiled Egg, and find a Gold Tag in a cutscene following the battle.
Washogun is required for a Baffle Board in Blossom Heights, just outside the Hot Springs. This allows access to Sproink's quest at the Hot Springs.
Washogun can also be battled on the Hexpress in Psychic Spectres. This is the only way to befriend Washogun without evolving a Brushido.

inspirit.name: Spruce Up
inspirit.description: Clean, virtuous power restores a little HP to the Inspirited Yo-kai.

soultimate.name: Spray Care
soultimate.description: Cleanses allies with his spray gun, restoring HP.

skill.name: Washed Out
skill.description: Stats decrease when negatively Inspirited.

name: Lie-in
profile: Lie-in can be befriended in the Bony Spirits exclusive quest Train Lie-in With Pride on Mt. Middleton.
He can also be found in the Tucked Away Lot in Blossom Heights, on Mystery Way - Back Road and in Gate of Whimsy battle rooms.
He can also be freed from the past Crank-a-kai with a Red Coin.
Lie-in has two equipment slots.

inspirit.name: Lionize
inspirit.description: The power of a lion awakes in the Inspirited Yo-kai. STR goes up.

soultimate.name: Paw 'n' Claws
soultimate.description: Serves up a serious beating to his foes with his bare hands.

skill.name: Hard Worker
skill.description: Receives more experience points.

inspirit.name: Lionize
inspirit.description: The power of a lion awakes in the Inspirited Yo-kai. STR goes up.

soultimate.name: Lion Blade
soultimate.description: Waits for the perfect moment before cutting foes with his sword.

skill.name: Lie-in Wait
skill.description: Doesn't take an action for one to two turns.

name: Hissfit
profile: Hissfit appears in The Catwalk (the alleyway behind Everymart Uptown) and Paradise Springs on a team with Squeeky. He can also appear in Gates of Whimsy. Alternatively, he can be found on Mystery Way - Route Two.
He also has a 5% chance to be freed from the present Crank-a-kai with a Red Coin.

inspirit.name: Meltdown
inspirit.description: The Inspirited Yo-kai, angry at everything, attacks its allies.

soultimate.name: Angry Crosscut
soultimate.description: In a rage, he waves his sword around and strikes all foes.

skill.name: Annoyance
skill.description: May attack an ally.

name: Zerberker
profile: Fuse Hissfit with a Raging Blade, which can be bought in Whatta Find.
He can also be freed from the past Crank-a-kai with a Red Coin.

inspirit.name: Berserk
inspirit.description: Irritates a foe and makes it attack its allies.

soultimate.name: Zerberker Slash
soultimate.description: Goes nuts with his cutters and slashes all of his opponents.

skill.name: Annoyance
skill.description: May attack an ally.

name: Snartle
profile: Snartle will appear the same way as in Yo-kai Watch. If the player go past crosswalks without pressing the button and waiting for the green signal five times in a row, Snartle will attack them. However, on the second attempt, the dialogue will be slightly different. On the third attempt, Gargaros will attack instead, restarting the cycle.

inspirit.name: Frighten
inspirit.description: Makes an enemy so scared of Snartle that it can hardly move.

soultimate.name: For Naughty Brats
soultimate.description: Goes nuts with his cutters and slashes his opponents.

skill.name: Sword Hunting
skill.description: Power increases each time it defeats a foe.

name: Mochismo
profile: Mochismo can be found on the first and third floors of Springdale Elementary School at night and on the second floor on a team with Mimikin and Mynimo.
Alternatively, he has a 5% chance to be freed from the present Crank-a-kai with a Red Coin.
He is required for a Baffle Board in Downtown Springdale in the Construction Site. After a few real-world days, the Sports Club will be built and accessible.

inspirit.name: Mochi Power
inspirit.description: Boosts STR with tasty mochi power.

soultimate.name: Mochi Punch
soultimate.description: Puffs up and decks an opponent with a mean punch.

skill.name: Soft Skin
skill.description: Increases Defense if dealt critical damage.

name: Minochi
profile: Minochi can be found in long grass in Downtown Springdale, in long grass and flower beds in Shopper's Row, in Gourd Pond Museum at night, Behind Frostia's Place and Springdale Elementary School at night. He can also be found in Gates of Whimsy and in the Springdale Railway.
He can be found in the Infinite Tunnel under 4999m.
He can also be freed from the past Crank-a-kai with a Red Coin.

inspirit.name: Jealousy
inspirit.description: Makes a foe so jealous of its allies that it will attack them.

soultimate.name: Minochi Punch
soultimate.description: Puffs up and decks an opponent with one mean punch.

skill.name: Soft Skin
skill.description: Increases Defense if dealt critical damage.

name: Tublappa
profile: Tublappa can be found under cars, in long grass and by graves in Old Springdale, on Fox Shrine Road, Well Road and in the Fleshy Souls Way entrance.
He can be found in the Infinite Tunnel between 2000 and 7999m.
He can also be freed from the past Crank-a-kai with a Red Coin and Special Coin.

inspirit.name: Sick Lick
inspirit.description: The Inspirited Yo-kai is licked, feels terrible, and is unable to act.

soultimate.name: Lickity-Lick
soultimate.description: Unfurls his lengthy tongue and does damage to all foes.

skill.name: Lickaway
skill.description: Purifies adjacent allies.

name: Slicenrice
profile: Slicenrice can be found in the Old Mansion and in Bony Spirits Way on Gogo Junction.  Slicenrice also has a rare form and sometimes appears with a Mentaiko nose instead of his usual pickled plum nose when under the Bony-Spirits faction.
He can also be befriended in the main story when you do the quest Slicenrice Under Fire (Fleshy Souls only).

inspirit.name: Power Snack
inspirit.description: The Inspirited Yo-kai's STR goes up due to yummy rice power.

soultimate.name: Onigiri Slash
soultimate.description: Leaps into the air and delivers a sword blow to a single foe.

skill.name: Rice and Dice
skill.description: Ups damage Yo-kai does to enemy's Oni.

name: Flamurice
profile: Evolve Slicenrice at level 31.
Flamurice also has a rare form and sometimes appears with a Mentaiko nose instead of his usual pickled plum nose when under the Bony-Spirits faction.

inspirit.name: Power Lunch
inspirit.description: The Inspirited Yo-kai's STR goes up due to yummy rice power.

soultimate.name: Toasted Slash
soultimate.description: Leaps into the air and delivers a sword blow to a single foe.

skill.name: Rice and Dice Firewall
skill.description: Ups damage Yo-kai does to enemy's Oni. Blocks damage from all Fire skill attacks

name: Helmsman
profile: Helmsman appears in the main house of the Old Mansion in Blossom Heights, in Sawayama Castle Town at night and on Mystery Way - Route One.
He also has a 5% chance to be freed from the present Crank-a-kai with a Red Coin.

inspirit.name: Helmet Defense
inspirit.description: Raise ally's DEF... As if it were wearing a helmet!

soultimate.name: Helmsman Helm
soultimate.description: Raises allies' morale and DEF

skill.name: Spirit Guard
skill.description: No elemental-weakness damage if guarding.

name: Reuknight
profile: Fuse Helmsman and Armsman.
He can also be freed from the Crank-a-kai using a Red Coin in the past.

inspirit.name: Knight's Curse
inspirit.description: Lower's a foe's SPR with the power of an undead knight.

soultimate.name: Knight's Slash
soultimate.description: Draws a sword from the hip and strikes all his foes with one blow.

skill.name: Spirit Guard
skill.description: No elemental-weakness damage if guarding.

name: Corptain
profile: After completing the main story, you will find a quest near the entrance to the Mt. Wildwood Sacred Tree Path. This will unlock the Yo-kai World where you meet Corptain and complete his request of stopping the fights in the 3 areas. After doing so, you will need to defeat the leaders in the 3rd area of the realm. After doing so, Corptain will be able to be battled and befriended each day through usual methods.

inspirit.name: Stygian Curse
inspirit.description: Drops a foe's SPR with a strange power from the underworld.

soultimate.name: Ticket to Hades
soultimate.description: Cuts his enemies. Likely to be either critical or a miss.

skill.name: Spirit Guard
skill.description: No elemental-weakness damage if guarding.

name: Mudmunch
profile: Mudmunch can be found in rice paddies in Old Harrisville.
He can also be freed from the past Crank-a-kai with a Red Coin or Special Coin.

inspirit.name: Sucking Mud
inspirit.description: The Inspirited Yo-kai loses HP due to anger about a rice field.

soultimate.name: Dirty Trick
soultimate.description: Focuses all his rage to attack and sap the STR of his foes.

skill.name: Sludge Grudge
skill.description: When defeated, takes revenge on enemy.

name: Sgt. Burly
profile: Sgt. Burly appears at random when the player manages to climb to the top of the flagpole at Springdale Elementary School, which can be done by climbing in intervals prior once a day. He can be fought by going to the rooftop of the school after spotting him there and can be befriended via the regular method.
He is required for a Baffle Board in Springdale Sports Club 2F. He increases the rate Gym Points can be gained.

inspirit.name: Fighting Fit
inspirit.description: The Inspirited Yo-kai boosts all stats at Burly's Beat Camp.

soultimate.name: Victoryyyyyyyy!
soultimate.description: Boosts all allies' stats with a stint in his Beat Camp.

skill.name: Gimme Twenty
skill.description: Boosts all adjacent Yo-kai's STR.

name: Blazion
profile: Blazion can be found in garbage, under vending machines and under cars in the Excellent Expressway.
He is required for a Baffle Board in Uptown Springdale outside Jungle Hunter. He allows certain bugs/fish to be traded in for 3x the amount of points.

inspirit.name: Emblaze
inspirit.description: Sets an ally's heart ablaze. This also raises its STR.

soultimate.name: Blazing Fist
soultimate.description: Burns enemies with the flaming power of his fighting spirit.

skill.name: Blazing Spirit
skill.description: Power increases when an ally is defeated.

name: Quaken
profile: Quaken can be found on Mount Wildwood - Mountain Path and the Bony Spirits Way exit.
He can be freed from the present Crank-a-kai with a Red Coin or Special Coin.

inspirit.name: Lion's Pride
inspirit.description: Stirs up an ally's heart, thus boosting its DEF stat.

soultimate.name: Earthshaker
soultimate.description: Shakes the earth and batters opponents with massive rocks.

skill.name: Courageous Spirit
skill.description: Power increases when an ally is defeated.

name: Siro
profile: Siro can rarely be found on the Mt. Wildwood Mountain Path. He can also be found in Gates of Whimsy.
He can be freed from the present Crank-a-kai with a Red Coin, either Crank-a-kai with a Butterfly Mystery Coin or Mon Mystery Coin, and the Destiny Oni Crank-a-kai.

inspirit.name: Heart's Roar
inspirit.description: Raises an ally's SPD with its roaring aura!

soultimate.name: Roaring Stance
soultimate.description: Massively increases the STR of allies with his fierce aura.

skill.name: Shining Spirit
skill.description: Power increases when an ally is defeated.

name: Chansin
profile: Chansin can be found in the Seaside Cave and Sawayama Castle Town at night.
He can also be freed from the present Crank-a-kai with a Special Coin and the past Crank-a-kai with a Red Coin.

inspirit.name: Bad Bet
inspirit.description: Makes the foe stop worrying about losing and lowers its DEF.

soultimate.name: Go for Broke
soultimate.description: Boosts STR of allies by increasing their focus on the battle.

skill.name: Gambler
skill.description: High chance to give and take critical strikes.

name: Sheen
profile: Fuse Chansin with the Legendary Blade. To get the Legendary Blade, fuse the Battered Blade (which can be bought at Jungle Hunter) with the Rough Whetstone (which can be found in the main story or through the lottery).
He can be freed from the Crank-a-kai with a Glitzy Coin or the Destiny Oni Crank-a-kai.

inspirit.name: Fine Weapon
inspirit.description: The masterwork blade Masamune boosts an ally's STR.

soultimate.name: Legendary Slash
soultimate.description: Cuts one foe with the blade of justice. High critical chance.

skill.name: Light Speed
skill.description: High chance to deal critical attacks.

name: Snee
profile: Fuse Chansin with the Cursed Blade. Fuse a Battered Blade (which can be bought from Jungle Hunter) with the Sinister Whetstone (which can be received in the story or the lottery) to get the Cursed Blade. Snee can also be found in Gera Gera Land (exclusive area to Psychic Specters).

inspirit.name: Cursed Sword
inspirit.description: Curses a foe with the blade Marumasa and drops the foe's SPD.

soultimate.name: Demonic Slash
soultimate.description: Dices all opponents with his cursed blade.

skill.name: Cursed Skin
skill.description: All stats will increase when inspirited by foe.

name: Gleam
profile: Fuse the Sublime Whetstone and the Battered Blade to obtain a Holy Blade that can be fused with Chansin. You get the Sublime Whetstone from the Oni Crank-a-kai while you get the Battered Blade for 600 Jungle Points at Jungle Hunter.
He can be freed from either Crank-a-kai with a Cheerful Coin and the Destiny Oni Crank-a-kai.

inspirit.name: Holy Sword
inspirit.description: The holy sword Kusanagi boosts an ally's STR.

soultimate.name: Holy Slash
soultimate.description: Slices a single enemy with his sacred sword. High critical chance.

skill.name: Light Speed
skill.description: High chance to deal critical attacks.

name: Benkei
profile: Benkei can be found in Gourd Pond Museum at night, on Mystery Way - Route 1 and in Sawayama Castle Town at night.
He can also be freed from the present Crank-a-kai with a Red Coin.

inspirit.name: Clumsiness
inspirit.description: Makes a foe clumsy. This decreases its SPR.

soultimate.name: 999 Blades
soultimate.description: Unleashes 999 blades and attacks all foes.

skill.name: Sword Hunting
skill.description: Power increases each time it defeats a foe.

name: B3-NK1
profile: B3-NK1 can be found in Gourd Pond Museum at night and behind the 20 Gate Globe Door.
He can also be freed from the past Crank-a-kai with a Red Coin and from the Destiny Oni Crank-a-kai.

inspirit.name: Cyborg Strength
inspirit.description: Raises an ally's DEF by making part of its body mechanical!

soultimate.name: B3-NK1 GUN
soultimate.description: Rapidly fires blades. Likely to be either critical or a miss.

skill.name: Sword Hunting
skill.description: Power increases each time it defeats a foe.

name: Sushiyama
profile: Sushiyama can be found under cars and porches in Harrisville, on the third floor of Nocturne Hospital, on Mystery Way - Route Three and Bony Spirits Way - Entrance. In Psychic Specters, he can be found in the kitchen and dining area in Wolfit Down, the latter on a team with Smogling; and in Sawayama Castle Town at night.
He can be found in the Infinite Tunnel between 5000 and 7999m on a team with Castelius III or Happierre and between 8000 and 19999m on a team with Dubbles.
He can be freed from the present Crank-a-kai with a Red Coin and from the past Crank-a-kai with a Special Coin.

inspirit.name: Samurai Spirit
inspirit.description: Raises an ally's STR with the spirit of an ancient samurai.

soultimate.name: Sushiyama Strike
soultimate.description: Smashes his pole onto a foe. High critical hit and miss chances.

skill.name: Guard Break
skill.description: Ignore foe's guard effect when attacking.

name: Kapunki
profile: Kapunki rarely appears under houses in Harrisville.
He can be freed from either Crank-a-kai with a Mystery Coin or Play Coins and the Mystery Way - End Point (Main Line) Crank-a-kai.

inspirit.name: Kabuki Fun
inspirit.description: Injects an ally with the soul of kabuki to raise its STR.

soultimate.name: Boastful Bomber
soultimate.description: Boldly bashes a foe with his pole. High critical/miss chance.

skill.name: The Stand
skill.description: Will keep 1 HP after a knockout blow once.

name: Beetler
profile: Beetler can be found on Mount Wildwood in the present at night, in long grass on a team with Skelebella and in the Gogo Junction on Fleshy Souls Way.

Beetler can also be befriended during the Which Beetle's Better request if a ★Miyama Stag is given to the boy that prefers stag beetles. After getting to Rank B and going back to the Harrisville School in the present, Beetler will appear and will be automatically befriended.

inspirit.name: Stag Power
inspirit.description: Boosts an ally's STR with the power of a stag beetle.

soultimate.name: Big Pincers
soultimate.description: Pinches a foe with... well, his pincers.

skill.name: Lone Soldier
skill.description: STR increases if there are no adjacent Yo-kai.

name: Beetall
profile: Fuse Beetler with a General's Soul. Unlike in Yo-kai Watch, Beetall can no longer be found in the wild.

inspirit.name: Fighter Power
inspirit.description: Boost's an ally's STR to make it a worthier fighter.

soultimate.name: Infernal Pincers
soultimate.description: Crushes an opponent with the huge pincers atop his head.

skill.name: Intimidation
skill.description: No Yo-kai will Loaf around.

name: Cruncha
profile: Cruncha can be freed from the present Crank-a-kai with a Red Coin, Special Coin or Five-Star Coin and either Crank-a-kai with a Kai Mystery Coin.
He can be found in the Infinite Tunnel between 5000 and 7999m.

inspirit.name: Legend Power
inspirit.description: Raises an ally's STR to transform it into a great warrior!

soultimate.name: The Guillotine
soultimate.description: Cuts an enemy with the massive pincers on his head.

skill.name: Intimidation
skill.description: No Yo-kai will Loaf around.

name: Demuncher
profile: Take the quest: Nyada's Trials II after beating the game and meet Demuncher at the top of Mt. Middleton in the past, where you can battle him once a day until he's befriended through the regular method. Befriending Demuncher completes the quest.

inspirit.name: Fightamins
inspirit.description: The Inspirited Yo-kai gets nasty nutrients. STR goes up.

soultimate.name: Open Wide
soultimate.description: Opens his massive mouth and chomps on a single foe.

skill.name: Sneaky Snacker
skill.description: Recovers HP after an enemy is defeated.

name: Devourer
profile: Devourer can be found in the Infinite Tunnel past 5000m.
He can be freed from the past Crank-a-kai with a Red Coin, Five-Star Coin or a Special Coin.
In Psychic Specters, he can be freed from the Happy-Go-Lucky Crank-a-kai with a Lucky Crank-a-Coin.

inspirit.name: Maulnutrition
inspirit.description: The Inspirited Yo-kai has its life snatched away. HP drains.

soultimate.name: Ill Appetite
soultimate.description: Opens his massive mouth and chomps on a single foe.

skill.name: Soul Snacker
skill.description: Recovers HP after an enemy is defeated.

name: Brokenbrella
profile: Brokenbrella can be automatically befriended following the fight with Eyeclone.
He can also be found on the 1st to 3rd circles of the Infinite Inferno.

inspirit.name: Tailwind
inspirit.description: The Inspirited Yo-kai benefits from a tailwind. SPD goes up.

soultimate.name: North Wind
soultimate.description: Whips up a whirlwind that turns him inside out and strikes all foes.

skill.name: Gust o' Gusto
skill.description: When in the back, increases allies' SPD.

name: Pittapatt
profile: Pittapatt is found on Fox Shrine Road; Well Road; under cars, porches and in long grass in Old Springdale; in bamboo groves on Mount Wildwood in the past and in the Fleshy Souls Way Entrance.
He can also be found in the Infinite Tunnel under 2000m.
He can also be freed from the past Crank-a-kai with a Yellow Coin.

inspirit.name: Bless My Sole
inspirit.description: The Inspirited Yo-kai gets a SPD boost from well-fitted sandals.

soultimate.name: Sole Quaker
soultimate.description: Uses power built up on his epic walks to strike every foe.

skill.name: Got Your Back
skill.description: When in back, slowly refills front row's HP.

name: Snotsolong
profile: Snotsolong can be found in the Secret Byway in Blossom Heights and sometimes in the Gates of Whimsy.
He can also be found on Mystery Way - Route Six.

inspirit.name: Runny Nose
inspirit.description: Gives a foe a nose so runny that it can't do anything but blow it!

soultimate.name: Stretchy Slap
soultimate.description: Slaps an opponent with its snot. May cancel Soultimate Moves!

skill.name: Water Play
skill.description: Increased damage of Water attacks.

name: Duchoo
profile: Duchoo can be found in the Springdale Underground Waterway.
He can also be found in the Infinite Tunnel between 2000 and 4999m.
He can be randomly encountered on the train on a team with Cutta-nah at level 6 among other teams.
He can be freed from the present Crank-a-kai with a Yellow Coin.

inspirit.name: Catch Cold
inspirit.description: Makes an enemy Yo-kai catch a cold. This will lower its STR.

soultimate.name: Sneezy Spike
soultimate.description: Slaps an opponent with its snot. May cancel Soultimate Moves!

skill.name: Snow Play
skill.description: Increased damage of Ice attacks.

name: D'wanna
profile: D'wanna can be found in Tranquility Apartments, under porches in Shopper's Row and in Paradise Springs.
He can also be freed from the present Crank-a-kai with a Yellow Coin.

inspirit.name: Full of Sighs
inspirit.description: Lowers an opponent's STR and makes it sigh constantly.

soultimate.name: Croaking Prayer
soultimate.description: Hinders foes with a chanted curse.

skill.name: Soothing Rhythm
skill.description: All foes will be prone to loafing.

name: N'more
profile: Evolve D'wanna at Level 15. In Psychic Specters, N'more can be found in the dining area and kitchen in Wolfit Down, the latter on a team with Ben Tover.

inspirit.name: Full of Sighs
inspirit.description: Lowers opponent's STR and makes them sigh constantly.

soultimate.name: Yawnehameha
soultimate.description: Hinders foes with a rolling wave of curses.

skill.name: Soothing Rhythm

Jibanyan tells his story to the player before he became a Yo-kai, however, unlike in Yo-kai Watch, the player doesn't have to take back the photo of Amy. He is notably one of the main characters of this game alongside Nate (or Katie) and Whisper most likely due to his main role in the anime.

The player comforts Jibanyan, and Jibanyan starts to get déjà vu. A strange light appears which signifies that Jibanyan's memories are being recollected. After the light, the player will receive Jibanyan's medal. While the player and Whisper both decide to go to the Memory Store to get a clue as to why they have lost their memories, Jibanyan stays near the fish place to continue his training, and later tags along.

name: Slimamander

If the quest isn't there, then you may have to rank up your watch to at least Rank B, or you may also need to complete the Ghost Club at School quest. You do not have to complete the game or have entered the Infinite Inferno to activate this quest. This quest is exclusive to Bony Spirits only. #Go to where you are supposed to (which is right outside of the school, where you first fought him) for the quest, and save right before you fight Slimamander. #Try bringing a Superstar Soul or a Yo-kai with the Popularity ability (Shmoopie, Cupistol, etc.). Even though he is a boss, it can slightly increase your chances of befriending him. # If you don't get him the first time, soft reset the game, and continue fighting him until his dialogue changes after fighting him and you get his medal. Unlike other Yo-kai he will befriend you judging on how well you battled, for example if you keep needing to heal every turn then he probably won't befriend you. It is recommended to try with at least a level 30 to 35 team. He won't approach you and instead talk to you before giving his medal.

name: Awevil
profile: Awevil can be encountered in a similar manner to how he appeared in the first game, though instead of levers found throughout the Springdale Underground Waterway, now it is through three keycards that you'll need to collect and use to open the floodgate in the middle of the Springdale Underground Waterway.

• The Blue Keycard can be found in a chest on the Springdale business tower's 4th floor, which can be unlocked via a Baffle Board outside the building (Illoo is required to activate this Baffle Board). • The Gold Keycard is acquired after completing "The Secret Base" request that is activated by talking to Alex near the sewer entrance in Breezy Hills. • The Red Keycard is given by the leader of the Sesame Club in the sewers. The player must speak with the 10 members scattered throughout the sewers by utilizing the various sewer entrances around Springdale to speak with them from behind their doors. Once all 10 have been spoken to, the player can speak with the leader to acquire the Red Keycard.

Once a keycard has been obtained, it can be used at the main floodgate in the middle of the sewers. Once all three are used, Awevil will appear, where he can be battled once per day until he's befriended through normal methods.

name: Wobblewok
profile: Wobblewok returns in this game, appearing first as the final boss of Infinite Inferno once again.

The circumstances of this battle are the same as the previous one, complete with the same dialogue. After Whisper reseals him again, a blue cord is lowered down, giving the player access to the Divine Paradise.

Wobblewok can be befriended in this game as well. Challenge Wobblewok until you collect a "Ghostly Goo" drop. It is recommended that you bring a Yo-kai with an ability that allows items to drop more often, or the equivalent Soul Gem (Buchinyan, Wantston, Yoink, Babblong, Bananose, Cynake or Slitheref's Soul Gems have this effect).

To continue, one must activate the Request "Nightmare Revelation" from Lucas after completing the "Back to Yo-kai World" Request, then go to the Mirror Shrine in to use the Ghostly Goo on a conveniently placed pot. You can also, if you prefer, activate the quest first and then find the goo, whichever way you like.
A new Wobblewok will be born after putting the goo in the pot and he'll automatically befriend you, ending the Request.

name: Sproink
profile: # Go to the baffle board in front of the hot springs at day and call Washogun, who will tell you to come back after he cleans it at night. # Come back at night speak to him then come back again the next day. He will tell you about a Yo-kai who is preventing him from cleaning, and ask you to deal with them. After coming back, use the Yo-kai lens on the circular pool in the hot springs. # Sproink will appear, and will start a battle. It is recommended to try with a level 30 team. After the battle, Sproink apologizes and tells you about a man who used to bathe with him all the time, wondering where he went. Go downstairs and talk to one of the men by the TV. He tells you the man is at a hospital in Downtown Springdale. # Go to the hospital and talk to the man on the second floor, who will give you a towel and tell you to give it to Sproink. Give it to Sproink, and he will automatically befriend you.

name: Gargaros
profile: Gargaros can no longer be fought in Terror Time as the oni bat the player away when approached. He however can be killed with items and will drop a large Oni Orb. He however still appears as a boss in the Irate Eight boss rush in Springdale Sports Club which is unlocked after beating Kat Kraydel.
Gargaros' appearance when changing the system time now also affects daily occurrences like putting money into the box at Mount Wildwood Shrine. Disallowing it for two real world days.

Gargaros can be befriended in Bony Spirits Way, in any version of the game, but you must have the 2.0 Oni Evolution Update and both Psychic Specters and Bony Spirits versions of the game. If you're playing Bony Spirits or Psychic Spectres, simply link both versions of the game and get the Spooky Key, Butterfly Key and Boar Key from Mr E outside of the Abandoned House in San Fantastico (location which becomes available by train during chapter 6). If you're playing Fleshy Souls, link with Bony Spirits and talk to Mr E, who will just give you the Spooky Key. Save, and then link with Psychic Spectres, which will make Mr E give you all 3 remaining keys.

Around halfway through the normal Mystery Way dungeon you will reach a room named Mystery Way - Ramp, where you should see an Eyepo, an Ignoculus, and up to 3 doors that will be unlocked when you've linked together the various versions of Yo-kai Watch 2.

Go through the door guarded by Arachnus to Bony Spirits Way. When you enter, you will step into Fullface Rock. Check the minimap to see the purple Yo-kai icon, and use the vine to climb that rock to find Gargaros. Because he is a boss, he does not accept food, and it's uncertain whether the popularity Skill or Superstar Soul increase his befriend chances at all. After the battle, he will not walk up to you like regular Yo-kai do; instead, his post-battle dialgue will change to indicate that you've impressed him, and give you his medal when he finishes talking. Like other 2.0 Yo-kai, he can't be used in Psychic Blasters.
